text: Hello! It's the weekend. No school today! Here is your weather report for Sunday, September 13. It's Sunday, a good day to rest and get ready for the week. Here in Shanghai, the day will be sunny from start to finish. The high will be 32 degrees, and the low will be 22 degrees. It will feel hot and sticky out there. You probably won't need a raincoat today. Here's something to notice: today is about 2 degrees warmer than yesterday. Do you think you can feel it? Stay cool, drink plenty of water, and find some shade! Looking ahead to tomorrow, it will be part sun and part cloud, reaching 30 degrees. Here's a question for you today: if you could bring one thing to the park, what would it be? That's your weather. Have a wonderful day!
